intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in the Ahmedabad region and both list NEET on this page. This page compares recorded fees and 2023 placements from our database opened in {{year}}, and flags a placement row that looks incomplete.

B.J. Medical College vs GMERS Medical College is a government medical comparison. B.J. Medical College, attached to a large civil hospital, has the only usable recorded year tuition and the stronger 2023 figures on this page.

sections.heading: B.J. Medical College vs GMERS Medical College for MBBS: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose B.J. Medical College if you want the recorded 2023 figures of a ₹9 lakh average and a ₹24 lakh highest package, and recorded tuition of ₹22,600 a year. Confirm the official government fee circular for your quota, including bonds and hostel charges.

Choose a GMERS college only after you have its official fee and placement notices. This page has no GMERS fee row, and its 2023 average and highest are both recorded as ₹1 lakh, which looks incomplete, so we do not treat those figures as a reliable comparison.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: B.J. Medical College has recorded MBBS tuition of ₹22,600 a year. Government medical fees in Gujarat vary by quota and can include bonds, deposits and hostel charges that are not in this row. Confirm the current official fee notice.
GMERS Medical College has no fee row on this page. Do not guess the fee. Get the official GMERS or state fee circular for the campus you have been allotted.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: B.J. Medical College's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹9 lakh and a highest package of ₹24 lakh. For an MBBS college these figures may describe a limited recorded set, not every graduate's first job. They are historical records, not a salary promise.

GMERS has a 2023 row with both average and highest recorded as ₹1 lakh. That looks incomplete, so this page does not use it as a head-to-head figure. Ask the allotted GMERS campus for its official report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both sides list NEET on this page. MBBS admission is through NEET-UG and the relevant state or All India counselling.
Read the current MCC and Gujarat admission committee notices for eligibility, domicile rules and bond conditions.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: B.J. Medical College is in Ahmedabad, attached to a major civil hospital. GMERS medical colleges are a group of state medical colleges; confirm the exact campus on your allotment letter.
Do not treat every GMERS campus as the same commute or the same hospital attachment.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On the data we can trust, B.J. Medical College is the more complete side: recorded year tuition of ₹22,600 and usable 2023 figures.
A GMERS seat can still be the right allotment for you, but this page cannot show its fee or a reliable placement comparison.
Confirm official fee, bond and counselling notices before you treat either recorded figure as your cost or your salary.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, B.J. Medical College or GMERS, for MBBS?
faqs.answer: B.J. Medical College has recorded tuition of ₹22,600 a year and 2023 figures of a ₹9 lakh average and a ₹24 lakh highest package. GMERS has no fee row here, and its recorded 2023 ₹1 lakh average and highest look incomplete, so we do not use them as a comparison.

faqs.question: What are the recorded MBBS fees?
faqs.answer: B.J. Medical College has recorded tuition of ₹22,600 a year; government quotas, bonds and hostel charges may sit outside this figure. GMERS has no fee record on this page. Use official state circulars.

faqs.question: Do both colleges accept NEET?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both list NEET on this page. MBBS admission is through NEET-UG and the relevant counselling.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: B.J. Medical College's recorded 2023 average is ₹9 lakh and the highest is ₹24 lakh. GMERS's recorded 2023 figures of ₹1 lakh average and highest look incomplete and are not used as a head-to-head here.

faqs.question: Are B.J. Medical College and GMERS in the same city?
faqs.answer: B.J. Medical College is in Ahmedabad. GMERS is a group of state medical colleges; confirm the exact campus on your allotment letter.
